description: Synthetic pairs for the offline number-attribution candidate signal, written before the slot table they measure. Every pair runs as written, in the direction it is written, so the zh->en and en->zh cases are separate entries. The swapped bucket moves one value onto another stat while keeping the same set of numbers on both sides: each case is one error. The natural_reorder bucket reorders clauses, changes voice or swaps the reading order of the same facts and must produce no candidate. The clean_multi_stat bucket keeps consistent multi-stat sentences, repeated values and single-stat segments, and must produce no candidate either. Text is hand-written in the style of skill, Echo, weapon, guide and announcement copy; none of it is game text.
